Privacy.

We use the name, email address, enquiry type and message you share to discuss your request. For questions about your data, write to manager@habits.lt.

External services

Table bookings are handled by Tablein. OpenStreetMap provides the location map. You can open directions in Google Maps and visit partner sites and event galleries.

Tablein — Privacy

Photography and maps

Your browser loads certain photographs and the map from external websites. Their servers receive technical information needed to handle the request, including your IP address.
